topic: GEOPOLITICS: Brent's 17% crash is already fading - settled $94.62 on 04/11 (from $113.43 on 30/10, lowest close since 31 Aug) then back near $100 by 06/11 on fresh tanker attacks; rupee 94.47 to 93.91, a six-month high; Delhi petrol unchanged at Rs 102.12; RBI: every $10 on Brent = ~49 bps of inflation

EVENT/MARKET ALERT (2:30 PM monitor): Sensex reclaimed 80,000 on 06/11/2026 - intraday high 80,080.59, up 718 pts (+0.90%), first time above 80,000 since 05/03/2026; rupee firmed to about 94 a dollar, strongest since April, on sliding crude; FIIs bought Rs 14,796 crore on 05/11, biggest single-day buy since Feb 2021; Nifty 24,698 (+0.66%)

MONEY STORY: the index is green, the portfolio is red - on 06/11/2026 Sensex traded ~+450 pts near 79,760 and Nifty above 24,600 despite a 5.52% Nasdaq crash, but Nifty Midcap 100 fell 1.2%, Smallcap 100 fell 1.7% and more NSE stocks fell than rose; M&M +4.5% on a 25% Q2 profit jump, Titan, TCS, Infosys led; engagement question 'Is your portfolio beating the Nifty?'

PRE-MARKET: overnight global cues - Nasdaq -5.52% to 24,315 (worst day since April 2025), S&P -4.36% to 7,354, Dow -3.44% to 51,523; Asia: Nikkei -5.8%, KOSPI -8.8% (circuit breaker), Hang Seng -1.6%; GIFT Nifty ~24,425; Nifty closed 24,536.60 (+2.40%), Sensex 79,310.01 (+2.60%), support 24,500 / Thursday low 24,308 / 24,800 August high; Brent ~$99, rupee 94.47; FIIs bought Rs 14,974.68 crore on 05/11

FINANCE 101: Net Short - FIIs net bought Rs 14,975 crore on 05/11/2026 (biggest single-day buy in over a year) yet stayed net short 1.37 lakh index futures, adding 48,541 shorts; hedging vs directional. Instagram: SIP vs Lumpsum carousel (SIP inflows record Rs 32,490 crore, Sep 2026)

EVENT/MARKET ALERT (2:30 AM monitor): Wall Street AI/chip selloff on 05/11/2026 - Nasdaq fell over 5% and is 11% below its record (correction), S&P 500 worst day since April 2025, chip index -10%, Nvidia -8%, AMD -14%; Gift Nifty 24,450 (-0.61%) after Nifty closed at 24,536.60

FESTIVAL GREETING: Dhanteras on 06/11/2026 - 24K gold Rs 14,642 per gram (Rs 1,46,420 per 10g), IBJA expects 12% higher Dhanteras sales after gold rose 4.56% in two days; jewellery carries 3% GST plus making charges vs coins and bars

EVENT/MARKET ALERT (6:30 PM monitor): SEBI circular dated 05/11/2026 - domestic clients and FPIs may take long or short positions in INR currency derivatives with NO underlying exposure up to USD 5 million notional, one combined limit across all rupee pairs and all exchanges; FPI total short positions capped at USD 5m and longs above that need Indian equity/debt backing; follows RBI's 10/10/2026 FX derivatives changes

EVENT/MARKET ALERT (10:30 AM monitor): US midterm sweep - Democrats won both chambers of Congress; Sensex hit 78,922.44 (+1,621.04 pts, +2.10%) and Nifty topped 24,391.95 (+431.35, +1.80%) on 05/11/2026, sixth straight winning session; Brent fell to $93.5/bbl, lowest since 30/08, after an 8.7% slide; rupee firmed to 94.36; India m-cap crossed Rs 500 lakh crore; FIIs bought Rs 7,284 crore on 04/11, fourth straight session

MARKET WRAP: FIIs net bought Rs 6,836.81 crore and DIIs net sold Rs 3,678.85 crore in the cash market on 03/11/2026 (NSE provisional) yet the index rose - Sensex 76,917.85 (+1,225.07 pts, +1.62%), Nifty 23,810.85 (+370.05 pts, +1.58%), fourth straight green day and a two-month high

GEOPOLITICS: gold ~30% below its January 2026 record just before Dhanteras - spot gold under $3,900/oz (one-year low) on 30/10/2026, MCX gold under Rs 1.40 lakh per 10g on 03/11/2026, October the worst October since 2008 (gold -7%, silver ~-18%); cause: oil-led inflation and December Fed hike bets, gold pays no interest; Dhanteras 06/11/2026

EVENT/MARKET ALERT (2:30 PM monitor): SEBI recommended scrapping the 12.5% LTCG tax for foreign investors (Reuters, 02/11/2026) and FM Sitharaman said she will consider the demand - Sensex rose 1,049 pts (+1.39%) to 76,741.90 and Nifty +293.50 (+1.25%) to 23,734.30 on 03/11/2026, adding about Rs 4 lakh crore to BSE market value (total Rs 486 lakh crore); FPI outflows Rs 2.91 lakh crore in 2026

MONEY STORY: foreign money owns the least of India since Dec 2011 - FPI stake in BSE-listed firms 14.02% at Sept quarter end (lowest since Dec 2011, Mint/CMIE), domestic MF ownership a record 11.59%, gap down to 2.43 pp from 4.77 pp; FIIs sold Rs 45,162 cr in October (NSE provisional) then bought Rs 9,420 cr in six sessions to 02/11, DIIs net sellers Rs 392 cr on 02/11; Nifty 4th straight up session, ~23,691 (+1.07%), Sensex ~76,626 (+1.23%) at noon 03/11

MONEY STORY: the consumer never got the slowdown memo - October gross GST Rs 2,31,290 crore (+22.9% YoY, fastest this fiscal, second-highest on comparable basis after April 2026's Rs 2,42,702 cr; net Rs 2,03,356 cr +25.6%), UPI record 25.47 bn payments worth Rs 31.53 lakh crore, car sales 5.25 lakh units (first month above 5 lakh); Sensex up ~900 pts / Nifty ~23,313 on the day

PRE-MARKET: Nasdaq -2.86% (25,437) on the AI-spend rout, worst month since March 2025, yet Gift Nifty ~23,290 (+~200 pts) on Brent cooling to $111 from $117.64; Nifty closed 23,053.10 with 23,200 the wall and 22,850 the floor, Sensex 74,459.53 with 75,000/73,800; rupee 94.94, FIIs bought Rs 3,598 cr Friday, US midterms 03/11

FINANCE 101: Crack spread - the gap between crude oil and the fuel a refiner sells. RIL's Q2 FY27 fuel cracks ran 3-3.7x YoY and O2C EBITDA hit Rs 25,203 cr (+67.9%), but Singapore's petrol crack fell from a record $50.53/bbl (1 Oct 2026) to about $11 (30 Oct 2026), lowest since March

EVENT/MARKET ALERT (6:30 PM monitor): Qatar's LNG carrier Al Mayeda was hit by unidentified objects on Friday 30/10, confirmed by Nakilat on Sunday 01/11 via the Qatar Stock Exchange; the US has told Gulf allies fresh strikes on Iran could begin as early as 04/11/2026, a day after the midterms; Brent Dec settled $117.64 on 30/10 (intraday $118) and India's crude basket averaged $120.46/bbl to 26/10, highest since March 2012; rupee 94.95 on 30/10

FINANCE 101: De-rating (P/E compression) - Nifty 50's 12-month forward P/E fell 31% from 24.8x in Sep 2024 to 17.2x in Sep 2026 (Bajaj AMC), while Q2 FY27 Nifty-50 profit is up about 19% YoY on results declared so far (Kotak); the multiple did the falling, not the earnings. Nifty P/E (TTM) 19.30 on 30/10/2026 (NSE).

MONEY STORY (weekend lesson): compounding math - Rs 5,000 a month for 20 years at an assumed 12% a year = Rs 12 lakh invested, about Rs 49.5 lakh back; first 10 years build ~Rs 11.5 lakh, the last 10 add ~Rs 38 lakh (end-of-month SIP convention); no live market call, Sunday market closed, Friday close Sensex 74,459.53 (+308.49, +0.42%) and Nifty 23,053.10 (+116.35, +0.51%)

GEOPOLITICS: RBI has reportedly proposed a Rs 50 lakh per-year sub-limit under the LRS for business travel, pilgrimages and high-ticket trips (reported 27/10/2026, no start date; education and medical likely exempt), inside today's $2.5 lakh (~Rs 2.37 cr) yearly cap; travel is ~60% of money Indians send abroad; rupee fell ~7% in 12 months from 88.84 to 94.95 (30/10 close, Reuters) and RBI is estimated to have sold $75-80 bn since June to slow the fall

MARKET ALERT: Brent Dec futures +2.5% to $117.75/bbl (intraday $118) on 30/10/2026, highest since end-April and a 4th straight monthly gain, ~13% up in October; a small boat fixed limpet mines to the hull of tanker MT Louise 1 ~25nm off Oman's Khasab - first successful limpet-mine strike in Hormuz since the US-Iran war began in Feb 2026; 27 Indian sailors aboard safe, shipping ministry says all 29 Indian crew across both vessels hit this week unhurt

FINANCE 101: ARPU (average revenue per user) - Jio Platforms' Q2 FY27 ARPU was Rs 218.8 a month, up 3.5% from Rs 211.4 a year earlier, on 44.2 GB of data per user and 542.4 million subscribers; towers are already built, so each extra rupee of ARPU lands almost straight in operating profit

MONEY STORY: Sensex rose 2.7% in October, its first monthly gain after August -1.5% and September -5.8%, yet FPIs net sold Rs 34,843 crore of Indian equities in the same month (NSDL, up to 30/10) - a green month foreign money sold into; lesson: a rising price is not proof the big money is buying

GEOPOLITICS: MCX December silver closed near Rs 1,85,300/kg on 30/10/2026 (-2.19%, PTI) against the Rs 4,20,048/kg record of 29/01/2026 - about 56% down and roughly Rs 2.35 lakh per kg; gold fell far less, so the gold-silver ratio is ~78:1 vs the 40-60 of past decades, because over half of silver demand is industrial (World Silver Survey: 657.4 of 1,130.6 Moz in 2025) and high rates slow factories; India cleared permits for ~6,500 tonnes of silver imports over six months (Reuters, 22/10/2026) before Dhanteras on 06/11, easing domestic premiums; India spent a record $12 bn on silver imports in FY26 and silver ETF inflows were Rs 1,974 crore in September

FINANCE 101: Holding company discount - Jio Platforms gained 26.8% over its Rs 1,119 issue price on debut (28/10/2026) while parent RIL fell 3.46% to Rs 1,158.50; RIL owns 64.5% of Jio after the fresh issue, but the market pays less for the parent than the sum of its parts, and a listed Jio price is what can slowly narrow that gap

PRE-MARKET: Nasdaq -1.38%, S&P -0.30%, Dow -0.25% overnight as Alphabet fell ~12% and AI-spending doubt returned; Asia sold off (Kospi, Nikkei deep red), GIFT Nifty ~23,000 vs Nifty close 22,936.75 - 22,800 the line, 23,000 the wall; Brent ~$115 on Iran strike fears, rupee 95.2; FIIs sold Rs 943 cr vs DIIs bought Rs 1,924 cr

MONEY STORY: Sensex +514 pts to 74,665 by noon (+0.69%) and Nifty 23,105 (+167, +0.73%), but only 1,201 stocks rose against 2,499 that fell; Nifty IT +1.7% after Cognizant's $5.66 bn Sept quarter met estimates and AI jitters sent money to Indian IT; Midcap 100 -0.54%, Smallcap 100 -0.86% - a green index hiding a broad selloff

GEOPOLITICS: India's 10-year G-Sec yield closed 7.39% on 29/10/2026 (-5 bps on the day, ~9 bps for the week) - the bond's first weekly gain in 11 weeks after yields rose over 70 bps across 10 straight weeks, a losing streak for prices not seen since at least 1998; US 10-yr fell to ~4.92-4.93% on 30/10 from 5.05% on 28/10; rupee 95.26; mutual funds bought ~Rs 4,000 cr of bonds this week; analysts still see 7.70-7.75% by December

MARKET WRAP: Sensex 74,459.53 (+308.49, +0.42%) and Nifty 23,053.10 (+116.35, +0.51%) closed green a second day on IT (+2.32%) and pharma; FIIs turned net BUYERS at Rs 3,598.54 crore while DIIs net sold Rs 817.51 crore (NSE cash market) - foreign money returned as domestic funds trimmed, even though Midcap 100 -0.93% and Smallcap 100 -1.85% fell

FINANCE 101: Rollover - closing this month's futures contract and reopening the same trade in next month's; Nifty rolled 72.65% of its futures into the November series, below its 74.78% three-month average, roll cost 0.29%; market-wide rollover 91.09%; BSE monthly expiry (Sensex, Bankex) on 29/10/2026

FESTIVAL GREETING: Shubh Karwa Chauth (Karaka Chaturthi) on 29/10/2026 - a big gold/jewellery buying day; MCX gold Rs 1,43,860 per 10g, retail 24K Rs 14,395 per gram; the metal carries 3% GST and making charges another 5%

GEOPOLITICS: Houthi missile strike claim on Saudi's Ras Tanura refinery (550,000 bpd); Brent settled $115.32 on 28/10 (+1%); India's crude basket averaged $120.46/bbl in October to 26/10, highest since March 2012; rupee near 95.4; Delhi petrol frozen at Rs 102.12 and diesel Rs 95.20 since 25 May while Icra puts diesel under-recovery near Rs 20/litre - who absorbs the gap

MARKET WRAP: Sensex 74,151.04 (+905.01 pts, +1.24%), Nifty 22,936.75 (+237.90 pts, +1.05%) on Fed hold and cheaper crude; realty, FMCG and PSU banks led, auto and cement slipped; NSE FII/DII cash data for 29/10 could not be confirmed by a second source, so the post quoted closing numbers only and did not guess flows

FINANCE 101: Fresh issue vs Offer for Sale - a fresh issue is brand-new shares, so the company gets the cash; an OFS is promoters selling shares they already own, so the sellers get it. Jio Platforms' Rs 30,213 crore IPO (listing 28/10/2026) was 100% fresh - 27 crore new shares, no OFS - with up to Rs 27,500 crore of net proceeds to repay/prepay borrowings at Reliance Jio Infocomm

PRE-MARKET: GIFT Nifty ~22,620 (-0.35%) points to a soft open after Dow +0.03%, S&P +0.60%, Nasdaq +1.18%; Nifty 22,749.75 support 22,600 / resistance 22,800; Jio Platforms lists today after its Rs 30,213 crore IPO; US Fed decision 11:30 PM IST; Brent $115.6, rupee 95.12

FINANCE 101: Max Pain - the strike where all open Nifty options pay out the least at expiry; Nifty closed 22,753.20 on 26/10/2026, max pain 22,750, biggest call OI 23,000, biggest put OI 22,500, PCR ~1.13, monthly expiry 27/10/2026; a positioning reference, not a forecast

GEOPOLITICS: record Rs 3.08 lakh crore (~$32.7 bn) of FPI outflows from Indian equities in 2026, nearly double 2025's Rs 1.66 lakh crore; October alone Rs 48,056 crore sold (to 25/10/2026); the money went to AI - Korea +72%, Taiwan +63%, India -19% in USD in CY26; DIIs bought Rs 6.83 lakh crore; Nifty -13% CY26; US 10-year yield ~5%

MARKET WRAP: Sensex 73,598.67 (-0.01%), Nifty 22,749.75 (-0.02%) - flat on monthly expiry day while Nifty Smallcap 100 rose 2.7% and midcaps ~1%, IT and private banks dragged; NSE FII/DII cash data for 27/10 not yet published at 8:30 PM so the post quoted closing numbers only and explicitly did not guess flows

GEOPOLITICS: rupee slid to 95.22 on 26/10/2026 (third straight fall, 84 paise in 3 sessions) on firm dollar, costly oil and FPI outflows of Rs 48,056 crore in October so far (vs Rs 29,631 crore bought in August); US Fed decides 28/10 at 11:30 PM IST, hold at 3.75%-4.00% expected, December hike pencilled in; costlier imports for phones, edible oil and foreign travel, tailwind for dollar-earning IT/pharma

MARKET WRAP: Sensex 73,606.75 (+0.66%), Nifty 22,753.20 (+0.68%) - first green close in 5 sessions, snapping a 4-day losing streak; FIIs net SOLD Rs 1,462.49 cr while DIIs net BOUGHT Rs 2,609.57 cr (DIIs out-bought FII selling by ~Rs 1,147 cr)

GEOPOLITICS: Brent crude back above $110/bbl (5-month high) as US-Iran peace talks stalled and 18 tanker attacks hit in two weeks; India imports ~88% of its crude, and every $10/bbl rise adds ~$13-14 bn to the import bill and feeds inflation and the rupee

MONEY STORY: the market opened +800 points (Sensex ~74,600) then gave it ALL back and slipped red by noon - Sensex -124 (-0.17%) to 73,728, Nifty -68 (-0.30%) to 22,820, breadth 3,056 falls vs 768 rises; Brent near $110 + FII selling drowned an IT-led bounce (Nifty IT +2%, LTTS +15%)

PRE-MARKET: overnight global cues - US mixed (Dow +1.02% to 52,496, S&P +0.28%, Nasdaq flat at 26,425); Asia mostly up (Nikkei +1.17%, Hang Seng -0.09%, KOSPI +3.93%); GIFT Nifty flat ~23,010; Nifty closed 22,889 / Sensex 73,853, resistance 23,000, support 22,700; Brent ~$110, rupee 94.78

FINANCE 101: Grey Market Premium (GMP) - the unofficial premium IPO shares fetch before listing; set by dealers not NSE/BSE/SEBI, experts rate it ~70-80% accurate; Jio Platforms IPO opened 21/10/2026 with GMP ~22%
CAROUSEL (Instagram): Rupee cost averaging - why SIPs love crashes; a fixed Rs 5,000 SIP buys more units in a fall (56 units at NAV 90) than in a rally (45 units at NAV 110)

GEOPOLITICS: India-US trade deal nears completion - Trump's 16/10 waiver lifted the threat of 100% tariffs on Indian goods over Russian oil; Rubio in Mumbai (20/10) said the deal is 'very close'; India's US-bound goods exports rose 21.8% in August to $8.32 bn

MONEY STORY: the 50-30-20 budgeting rule - split take-home pay into 50% needs, 30% wants and 20% savings; on a Rs 50,000 monthly take-home that is Rs 25,000 / Rs 15,000 / Rs 10,000 (timeless lesson; NSE/BSE closed for Dussehra on 20/10/2026)

FINANCE 101: Anchor Investor - big institutions are allotted shares a day before an IPO opens; Jio Platforms' Rs 8,110 crore anchor book drew over Rs 2.5 lakh crore in bids (30x+), ahead of India's biggest-ever Rs 30,213 crore IPO opening 21/10/2026

FESTIVAL GREETING: Happy Dussehra / Vijayadashami on 20/10/2026 - 10th day of Navratri and the close of Durga Puja (markets closed); Vijay Muhurat 1:59-2:45 PM; festive-season demand for autos, durables, jewellery, retail

MARKET WRAP: Sensex 73,852.90 (-1.17%), Nifty 22,888.95 (-1.11%) snapped a 2-day winning streak as private banks and IT dragged; FII net sold Rs 1,148.64 cr (lowest October outflow) vs DII net bought Rs 3,201.19 cr - the index still fell despite DII buying
